description:
Call this FIRST, with part "core": the AILANG teaching prompt for programs
this sandbox runs (syntax, effects, pattern matching, contracts, common
mistakes). AILANG is not in your training data the way Python is; code
written without it rarely type-checks. part "reference" adds types, the
JSON/maps/regex/strings libraries and worked examples. For one stdlib
function, use stdlib_search or stdlib_module.
name: ailang_prompt
title: AILANG syntax prompt
